title: See where you gain. See where you lose.
captions:
See where you gain. See where you lose. 📈

The Kart Connect Data Logger puts speed against distance for every lap on one chart, so you can lay your lap over a team-mate's and see EXACTLY where the time goes.

Carrying more speed through the hairpin? Losing it on the exit of the fast one? It's all in the trace. 🏁

title: Press record. We'll sync it.
captions:
Press record. We'll sync it. 🎥

Film your session on a GoPro Hero 7 or newer, or a DJI Osmo Action, and the Kart Connect Data Logger lines your footage up with your logger data automatically.

GoPro: synced from the GPS timestamp on every frame.
DJI: just drop in the .srt file.

Then watch two laps side by side with a live delta showing who's ahead, frame by frame. 🔥

Coming soon. 🏁
